L.audio_profile: A cheerful woman of 25 with a bright, warm, quick voice; standing in a busy street on a cool evening, speaking up a little over the crowd, pleased with what she is holding; natural and unpolished, like a friend filming a vlog.

T.audio_profile: A tall, calm man of 30 with a low, dry, casual voice; slow, proud, deadpan and fair-minded; he never raises his voice.

dialogue_turns.text: [bright, to the camera, showing it off] Basketball night! Look what I got!
[flat and low, looking at it] That's the other team's.
[turning to him, plain and light, a simple fact] It's nicer.
[a beat; honest, giving her that, the weight on the word is; then low, firm and final] It is nicer. Put it away.

payload.scene: A phone vlog in the street outside an indoor arena on the evening of a basketball game, a little before it starts. Home fans stream past; a light evening wind. Luna holds the phone at arm's length and talks to it while she holds up a scarf she has just got; Timo stands upright just behind her.
payload.sample_context: A nine-second comedy sketch played by two close friends who bicker. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. LUNA, about 25, is cheerful and quick; she is delighted with the scarf she has just got, and to her 'it's nicer' is a plain fact, said without sarcasm and without apology. TIMO, about 30, is slow, dry and proud; he never raises his voice; he is honest enough to agree with her and firm enough to have the scarf put away all the same. They answer each other fast, with no gaps between the lines.

text: Basketball night, look what I got. That's the other teams. It's nicer. It is nicer. Put it away.
